# ARENQ brand artwork

Investor Desk's fixed INVESTOR, DESK and ID artwork was typeset from Arenq, designed by **Paulo R (skomii), 2014**. The wordmark retains the default uppercase glyph outlines except for the first I. That letter uses a custom capped double-line shape, with top and bottom bars instead of the original H-like middle crossbar. The opening title uses a wider I with the same color, glow and optical stroke as the rest of the word; compact wordmarks use a narrower version. Subsequent letters are shifted to retain their spacing. The selected custom C emblem replaces the earlier font-derived ID monogram. The SVG rendering uses a small optical stroke so the thin outlines remain visible at compact sizes.

Original author distribution: https://www.dafont.com/arenq.font (downloaded September 12, 2026). The original notice grants free personal and commercial use; it is preserved verbatim in [arenq-license.txt](arenq-license.txt). This is not an OFL font.

Source and deployed OTF SHA-256: `9cb5ccda0a0d5715c409df09758b1211e408646952ac6ebae8b8bfa3fe0706a3` (15,128 bytes). The original unchanged font is served locally by `next/font/local` for the user's requested ROME outline typography throughout the website. Unsupported characters fall back to the existing DM Sans face. Names, glyphs, metrics, copyright and embedding flags are unmodified. The author's source notice and embedded license grant free personal and commercial use; neither states a website embedding prohibition.

The fixed wordmark was shaped with CoreText at 1000 units/em and exported with coordinates rounded to 0.001 unit. HTML text preserves accessible names and search/heading semantics. Body text, fields, tables and values use ARENQ; action labels use the separately licensed HIGH TIDE family. The selected custom emblem is described in `emblem-c.md`.

A 0.3px CSS optical text stroke keeps the very fine outline strokes visible at interface sizes. This is a rendering treatment, not a modification to the font file. HIGH TIDE action labels reset that stroke.
